caption: The drawing depicts a single curved object that appears to be a sled or similar conveyance. The main body is an elongated, shallow, semi-cylindrical structure with high, upturned ends; it is predominantly rendered in various shades of grayish-blue and green, with darker patches suggesting texture or shading. The rim and outer edge of the structure are outlined in a pale gray color, and there is a wide reddish-brown band accenting the rear end. At the front, two upright posts support a rectangular brown platform attached with two sets of thin ropes, also brown, leading from the posts to the outer edge of the platform. The sled features some brown strapping or fastenings at intervals along its body, and the interior includes faint divisions or seams. The background is plain and uncolored, keeping the focus entirely on the object.
title: Red River Dog Sled
